title: Common providers: China (mainland)
coverage: Partial. Covers the four state-owned basic carriers and the two national academic networks, with their backbone AS numbers only; provincial networks, regional cable and private resellers are not listed.
missing: The provincial and city AS numbers of China Telecom, China Unicom and China Mobile (several hundred; only the national backbones are listed)
An AS number and a website for 中国广电 (China Broadnet): none confirmed
The website of 中国电信 (it refused an automated request on the read date)
Provincial cable networks (now grouped under China Broadnet) and private broadband resellers: no public list was readable, so none is named
The licence register of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology was not readable by an automated request, so licensed operators could not be checked against it

sources.name: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT)
sources.terms: No reuse terms were found on the page on the read date: nothing is copied.
sources.result: The home page answered. No operator register could be read (the licence lookup is an interactive service). It is the authority for licensed operators; AS numbers of mainland China are assigned through CNNIC.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in China
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 4 of 6 entries were found on the page under their name or one of their other names.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications industry in China
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 3 of 6 entries were found on the page under their name or one of their other names.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in China
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 5 of 6 entries were found on the page under their name or one of their other names.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 4 of 6 websites answered an automated check; an address that did not answer, or that refused an automated request, is left empty. No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 9 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: APNIC RDAP (the registry's own record of an AS number)
sources.terms: The APNIC Whois terms allow lookups for internet operational purposes and forbid bulk copying or redistribution without consent: nothing is copied.
sources.result: Read where the holder name in RIPEstat did not name the provider plainly.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: 中国电信
providers.notes: AS4134 is the ChinaNet backbone and AS4809 is CN2. Provincial networks hold AS numbers of their own; the international arm is China Telecom Global (Hong Kong pack).

providers.name: 中国联通
providers.notes: AS4837 is the China169 backbone and AS9929 is the Industrial Internet backbone (formerly China Netcom). The international arm is China Unicom Global (Hong Kong pack).

providers.name: 中国移动
providers.notes: Mobile and fixed. AS9394 is China Tietong, its fixed-line subsidiary. The international arm is China Mobile International (Hong Kong pack).

providers.name: 中国广电
providers.notes: The fourth basic carrier (cable and 5G), formed from the provincial cable networks.

providers.name: CERNET
aka: 中国教育和科研计算机网
providers.notes: The national education and research network. AS23910 is CERNET2, its IPv6 backbone.

providers.name: 中国科技网
aka: 中国科学院计算机网络信息中心
providers.notes: Research network of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.
